title: Building Parts
description:
4.3 million building parts — sub-features that refine a parent building's shape, height, or roof where a single footprint is not enough to describe the structure. A tower on a podium, a wing at a different height, or a distinct roof section each become a part.

Every part references its parent through `building_id`, which joins to `id` in [Buildings](../building/collection.json). The [agent guide](AGENTS.md) carries that join as a runnable query.

This collection is small relative to Buildings — 4.3 million parts against 2.53 billion footprints — because parts exist only where a source described the structure in that much detail, which in practice means predominantly OpenStreetMap-mapped areas.

Field definitions come from the [Overture building_part schema reference](https://docs.overturemaps.org/schema/reference/buildings/building_part/).

providers.name: Overture Maps Foundation
providers.description: Overture Maps Foundation is a collaborative effort of its members to build open, interoperable map data. It assembles, conflates, and quality-checks the source datasets behind this collection and publishes them on a monthly cadence.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Stable feature identifier. Where the feature is part of the Global Entity Reference System (GERS), this is its GERS ID and can be used to join Overture releases to each other and to external datasets.

table:columns.name: names
table:columns.type: struct<primary: string, common: map<string, string>, rules: list<struct<variant: string, language: string, perspectives: struct<mode: string, countries: list<string>>, value: string, between: list<double>, side: string>>>
table:columns.description: All known names for the feature. `primary` is the main name; `common` maps language codes to translations; `rules` carries variants that apply only in a given language, along a linear range, or from a given geopolitical perspective.

table:columns.name: height
table:columns.description: Height of the building or part in metres, measured from its lowest point to its highest point.

table:columns.name: min_height
table:columns.description: Altitude above ground in metres where the bottom of the building or part starts. Non-zero for features such as a skywalk or an overhanging upper storey.

table:columns.name: is_underground
table:columns.description: Whether the entire building or part sits completely below ground.

table:columns.name: num_floors
table:columns.description: Number of above-ground floors of the building or part.

table:columns.name: num_floors_underground
table:columns.description: Number of below-ground floors of the building or part.

table:columns.name: min_floor
table:columns.description: Start floor of this building or part.

table:columns.name: facade_color
table:columns.description: Facade colour in `#rgb` or `#rrggbb` hex notation.

table:columns.name: facade_material
table:columns.description: Outer surface material of the facade.

table:columns.name: roof_material
table:columns.description: Outer surface material of the roof.

table:columns.name: roof_shape
table:columns.description: Shape of the roof, such as `flat`, `gabled`, or `hipped`.

table:columns.name: roof_direction
table:columns.description: Bearing of the roof ridge line in degrees clockwise from north.

table:columns.name: roof_orientation
table:columns.description: Orientation of the roof shape relative to the footprint — `along` or `across`.

table:columns.name: roof_color
table:columns.description: Roof colour in `#rgb` or `#rrggbb` hex notation.

table:columns.name: roof_height
table:columns.description: Height of the roof in metres, from the base of the roof to its highest point.

table:columns.name: level
table:columns.description: Z-order of the feature, where 0 is ground level. Used to resolve draw order where features overlap, such as a bridge over a road.

table:columns.name: sources
table:columns.type: list<struct<property: string, dataset: string, license: string, record_id: string, update_time: string, confidence: double, between: list<double>, provider: string, resource: string, version: string>>
table:columns.description: Provenance for the feature: which upstream dataset each property came from, the record id in that dataset, its license, and when it was last updated. `property` is a JSON pointer to the field the entry explains; an empty pointer covers the whole feature.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry as WKB, in EPSG:4326 (longitude, latitude). This is the GeoParquet primary geometry column.

table:columns.name: building_id
table:columns.description: The `building.id` this part belongs to. Every building part is associated with a parent building feature through this field; use it to reassemble a building and its parts.

table:columns.name: version
table:columns.description: Version of this feature. Incremented by Overture whenever the feature changes between releases.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, xmax: double, ymin: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the feature geometry, stored as a struct so that readers can filter on it with Parquet row-group statistics before decoding any geometry.
